candidate.user_input: What are the rules regarding forwarding confidential work emails to personal email addresses and automated forwarding of emails from a team member account?
candidate.reference: Forwarding of confidential business emails or documents to personal external email addresses is prohibited. Automated forwarding of emails from a team member account is also prohibited.
